title: What Happens on a Free Walking Tour: Quick Summary
items: **A free walking tour has no ticket and no fixed price:** you join without paying up front and tip at the end what the walk was worth to you.
**It is two hours on foot** through the historic core of the former East Berlin, at a comfortable pace on mostly flat ground.
**Thirteen stops, Alexanderplatz to Hackescher Markt:** from the World Clock and the TV Tower to Museum Island and the old courtyards.
**No sales trap:** the tip is your call at the end, in cash or by card, with no set figure announced to the group.
**A good fit** if you are new to Berlin, want the centre explained rather than just photographed, and can walk for two hours.
**A poor fit** if you cannot walk two hours or want to go inside the museums; we walk the edges of Museum Island, not the galleries.
**My move: scrub through the whole route above before you book,** so nothing about the two hours is a surprise.
